name: anlide/hilos
description: Hilos v2 - High-performance cluster framework with lightweight daemon

scripts.ollama:stop: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml rm -sf ollama-local ollama-local-gpu-nvidia ollama-local-gpu-amd
scripts.ollama:pull: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b && docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
scripts.ollama:pull-gpu-nvidia: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local-gpu-nvidia ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b && docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local-gpu-nvidia ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local-gpu-nvidia ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
scripts.ollama:pull-gpu-amd: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local-gpu-amd ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b && docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local-gpu-amd ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T ollama-local-gpu-amd ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
scripts.test:framework:install-deps: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli-test composer install --no-interaction
scripts.test:framework:down: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml rm -sf mysql-framework-test hilos-cli-test
scripts.test:framework:down-volumes: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml rm -sf mysql-framework-test hilos-cli-test && docker volume rm -f hilos-framework-mysql-test-data
scripts.test:framework:unit: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c framework/tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite unit
scripts.test:framework:integration: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c framework/tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite integration
scripts.test:framework:phpunit: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c framework/tests/phpunit.xml
scripts.test:framework:all: composer run test:framework:install-deps && composer run test:framework:up && composer run test:framework:phpunit && composer run test:framework:down
scripts.test:framework:frontend:install: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-frontend-cli npm ci
scripts.test:framework:frontend:build: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-frontend-cli npm run build
scripts.test:framework:frontend:check: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-frontend-cli npm run check
scripts.test:framework:frontend:unit: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-frontend-cli npm run test
scripts.test:framework:frontend:lint: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-frontend-cli npm run lint
scripts.test:framework:frontend:format-check: docker compose -f framework/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-frontend-cli npm run format:check
scripts.test:framework:frontend: composer run test:framework:frontend:check && composer run test:framework:frontend:unit && composer run test:framework:frontend:lint && composer run test:framework:frontend:format-check
scripts.test:frontend:all: composer run test:framework:frontend:install && composer run test:framework:frontend:build && composer run test:framework:frontend && composer -d demo/chat run test:check && composer -d demo/chat run test:e2e-full && composer -d demo/simple-todo run test:check && composer -d demo/simple-todo run test:e2e-full && composer -d demo/simple-poll run test:check && composer -d demo/simple-poll run test:e2e-full
